nusmp.dive.upgrade: The spirit's other half joins you: the full dive.
nusmp.page.book_wind.spirit_dive: Spirit Dive - Sylph, the wind spirit, a tiny winged fairy, merges into you. Your first dives transform only the LEFT half of your body: one wing of wind, half a crown, a ring round your wrist. Later dives (or mastery) give both wings, the full crown and a ring on each wrist. A great boost to power, speed and senses; the natural mana around you flows into your body while the dive lasts. Cast it again to end it.
nusmp.page.book_water.spirit_dive: Spirit Dive - Undine, the water spirit, an elegant mermaid, merges into you. Your body is cloaked in the Valkyrie armour of water; once the dive is full it becomes the Saint Valkyrie Dress: feathered wings, a halo, white, gold and blue. A great boost to power, speed and senses; the natural mana around you flows into your body while the dive lasts. Cast it again to end it.
nusmp.page.book_fire.spirit_dive: Spirit Dive - Salamander, the fire spirit, a massive dragon, merges into you. Your arms are cloaked in intense fire mana with draconic scales and claws, and wings of fire open on your back (small ones at first, the full pair later, with draconic greaves and chest). A great boost to power, speed and senses; the natural mana around you flows into your body while the dive lasts. Cast it again to end it.
nusmp.page.book_earth.spirit_dive: Spirit Dive - the earth spirit (its name and face were never shown) merges into you. Your body is clad in mossy plates of living stone; a full dive adds stone greaves, a crown of crystals and rocks that float around you. A great boost to power, toughness and senses; the natural mana around you flows into your body while the dive lasts. Cast it again to end it.
